description: Visual assets manifest for scenes 01-03 of the AI history documentary

scene_01.description: Dartmouth Conference image: monochrome vintage conference room with blackboard showing mathematical equations
scene_01.keyword_or_prompt: Dartmouth conference 1956 meeting room mathematics blackboard vintage academic

fallback_generation.keyword_or_prompt: Black and white vintage 1956 conference room with researchers and mathematicians writing equations on blackboard, historical academic setting, monochrome

scene_01.license_note: Must use public domain, CC0, or explicitly royalty-free images. No rights-uncertain content.
scene_01.acquisition_notes: Priority: stock image of 1950s academic/conference setting with blackboard. If unavailable, generate via imagegen. Must convey historical authenticity and mathematical context.

scene_02.description: Line chart animation showing AI boom and bust cycles: alternating peaks (boom) and valleys (bust)
scene_02.keyword_or_prompt: AI history boom and bust cycle line chart with multiple peaks and valleys, growth and decline alternating pattern, professional dark background, statistical graph visualization
scene_02.license_note: Generated image - no licensing concerns. Ensure readable data labels and professional appearance.
scene_02.acquisition_notes: Generate via imagegen. Chart should show at least 3-4 complete boom/bust cycles to illustrate the pattern. Include clear axis labels and legend if applicable.

scene_03.description: B-roll composite: people using smartphones for chatbot AI (foreground) overlaid with modern urban cityscape (background)

sub_assets.description: B-roll footage: people using smartphones, chatbot/mobile app interaction, conversational AI usage
sub_assets.keyword_or_prompt: people using smartphone chatbot AI conversation mobile app interaction, close-up hands, modern lifestyle
sub_assets.license_note: Must allow commercial reuse. CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, or commercial royalty-free stock preferred. No rights-uncertain content.
sub_assets.acquisition_notes: Seek B-roll with diverse demographics, modern urban or casual settings. Footage should show clear interaction with mobile devices.

sub_assets.description: Background: modern urban cityscape with contemporary architecture, daytime or evening lighting
sub_assets.keyword_or_prompt: modern urban city skyline contemporary architecture bustling lifestyle, daytime or evening

fallback_generation.keyword_or_prompt: Modern urban cityscape with tall contemporary buildings, vibrant city life, daytime lighting, skyline view

sub_assets.license_note: Must allow commercial reuse. CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, or commercial royalty-free stock preferred.
sub_assets.acquisition_notes: Seek dynamic cityscape footage that can serve as subtle background layer. Slower pans or static shots work best for overlay composition.

scene_03.composite_notes: Scene 03 requires compositing: overlay scene_03a (people + mobile) on top of scene_03b (cityscape) with appropriate blending mode (e.g., screen, overlay) and opacity adjustment. Timing should sync with narration.

acquisition_workflow.step_1_library_search: Check assets_library/ for existing clips matching keywords (currently empty)
acquisition_workflow.step_2_stock_search: Run tools/stock.sh with provided keywords for each scene
acquisition_workflow.step_3_generation: If stock unavailable, run tools/imagegen.sh with provided prompts
acquisition_workflow.step_4_validation: Verify resolution 1920x1080 minimum, aspect ratio compliance, no copyrighted/identifiable content
acquisition_workflow.step_5_placement: Move acquired assets to assets/2026-07-08/visuals/ with target_filename
acquisition_workflow.step_6_manifest_update: Update status from 'pending_acquisition' to 'acquired' once files are placed

quality_requirements.licensing: Public domain, CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, or explicit commercial-use permission only. No ambiguous licenses.
quality_requirements.forbidden_content: No identifiable logos, real people's faces, third-party copyrighted materials, watermarks in final assets
